definitions.gloss: high image quality; high resolution; high definition
definitions.explanation: A high level of visual quality in a photo, video, display, or camera — sharp, clear, and with fine detail. Used both as a noun and, with の, as a modifier meaning high-quality or high-resolution.

examples.japanese: {高画質|こうがしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高画質|こうがしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧です。
examples.english: This TV is famous for its high image quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{高画質|こうがしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ファイル→ファイル：05280_fairu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When you save videos in high quality, the files become large.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高画質|こうがしつ}な⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{撮|と}れる→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: Recent smartphones can easily take high-resolution photos.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{高|こう}→高〜：03951_kou⟧ (high) and ⟦{画質|がしつ}→画質：16156_gashitsu⟧ (image quality). Refers to sharpness, resolution, and fidelity of photos, video, and displays. It is commonly used on product packaging, streaming service settings, and camera specifications.

USAGE:
- As a noun: {高画質|こうがしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧ (shoot in high quality)
- As a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-modifier: {高画質|こうがしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧ (a high-definition TV)
- Occasionally used as a な-adjective in casual writing: {高画質|こうがしつ}な⟦{映像|えいぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高画質|こうがしつ}⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧: high-quality video
- {高画質|こうがしつ}⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧: a high-resolution image
- {高画質|こうがしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{配信|はいしん}する→配信する：23206_haishinsuru⟧: to stream in high definition
- {高画質|こうがしつ}⟦モード→モード：11596_moodo⟧: high-quality mode

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{低画質|ていがしつ}→低画質：23669_teigashitsu⟧: low image quality — the direct antonym
- ⟦{高解像度|こうかいぞうど}→高解像度：26204_koukaizoudo⟧: high resolution — more technical, emphasizes pixel count rather than overall picture quality
- {高精細|こうせいさい}: high definition, fine detail — often used for displays and broadcast video
